g.text: Exploratory analysis: positive primary estimate, sensitivity to controls and trait labels
34 H6 catchments; 29 genera. All resampling fits converged. The bootstrap uses the same primary estimate.
The trait-label reference is not an exact adjusted beta-only null test. High host-score coverage analysis stopped for insufficient support.
Plant NUTRI SD = 0.3841 score units. Recorded identity contrasts do not measure abundance or temporal population change.
